metaTitle: Custom Full Color Cables & Cords | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color cables & cords for your brand. Vibrant, all-over prints ideal for trade shows and giveaways. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Full color decoration on cables and cords allows you to print logos, patterns, or even photographic imagery across the entire surface. Unlike single-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to match complex brand palettes or create eye-catching designs that stand out at trade shows and events. Products like the Juice Tech Kit and Metallic 3 in 1 Charging Cable are popular choices for businesses wanting a functional giveaway that doubles as a mini billboard.
